_ytflow_note: PARKED, not broken. This graph executes correctly on the installed IC-Light v1 fbc nodes and satisfies the sprite contract (832x1216 in, 832x1216 RGBA out, alpha preserved to within 1/255 of the source silhouette) — the first time Tier 3 has ever produced an image since Story 8.7 built the plumbing. It is left unverified because the OUTPUT is not good enough, not because the wiring is wrong: IC-Light v1 is trained on photoreal subjects and these cards are flat anime illustration, so the relight drags the art toward photoreal shading and loses skin tone and contrast. Probed denoise 0.45 / 0.60 / 0.85 (2026-08-02): washed grey, near-black, and blue-monochrome respectively — non-monotonic, all worse than the unlit card. Jay's call was to ship the ground-plane fix with Tier 1/2 harmonization instead, which approximates without re-rendering the art. Keeping ytflow_verified_iclight=false means _load_iclight_workflow treats this as a cache miss and Tier 3 never fires.
